requirements.title: Detection performance specified, verified and declared
requirements.statement: Detection performance of the AI function is specified, verified against prior-defined statistical thresholds, and declared.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Performance metrics selected and justified
requirements.statement: Performance metrics are selected and their appropriateness for the safety function is justified.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Metric set documented with justification per safety-relevant output.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Example: recall per distance band and person pose; false-negative rate as primary safety metric.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Acceptance thresholds defined before testing
requirements.statement: Acceptance thresholds are defined before testing and derived from the required risk reduction.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Thresholds dated before test execution; derivation from PL/SIL/AI-SC shown.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Results meet thresholds with stated confidence
requirements.statement: Test results per HARA scenario meet the thresholds with stated statistical confidence.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: All scenarios meet thresholds at the stated confidence level.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Accuracy declared in IFU
requirements.statement: Achieved accuracy levels and metrics are declared in the instructions for use.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: IFU section states metrics, levels and influencing conditions.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Single fault does not lead to hazardous situation
requirements.statement: A single fault in hardware or logic of the safety function does not lead to a hazardous situation.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Redundant channel
requirements.statement: Fault tolerance is achieved by a redundant (diverse) channel.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Second channel present; common-cause failures analysed.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Diagnostics with fail-safe reaction
requirements.statement: Faults are detected by diagnostics and lead to a safe state within the process safety time.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Diagnostic coverage and reaction time demonstrated by fault injection.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: No unexpected start
requirements.statement: No unexpected start on control-system fault or on interruption/restoration of power or network connection.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No start in fault-injection and power-cycle tests.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Event logging over lifetime
requirements.statement: Safety-relevant events, interventions and software versions are logged automatically over the lifetime.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Log specification covers events, interventions, versions; retention defined.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Noise emission minimised
requirements.statement: Risks from airborne noise are reduced to the lowest level, in particular at source.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Post-market monitoring system
requirements.statement: A documented, proportionate post-market monitoring system collects and analyses performance data.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: PMM procedure and plan exist and cover AI performance data.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Supervisor information complete
requirements.statement: The supervisory function gives a complete and accurate view of operation and safe positioning.

refines.note: refiner N/A by rule -> no substitution

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Supervisor HMI shows operation, movement and position.
requirements.author: Sample author

requirements.title: Demo: output confidence reported
requirements.statement: The AI function reports a confidence value with each output.
requirements.author: Test
requirements.notes: Reached only by the private pack DEMO.
